world.title: "Hatred In Their Hearts": Trump Blames Immigrants For Unrest In France
world.summary: US President Donald Trump attributed the recent unrest in France to immigration, stating that it involves individuals from "an entirely different world." The unrest, which included burnt barricades and looted shops, originated from student protests demanding more teachers and improved school conditions. Trump's comments came as France faced significant turmoil, with a historic town hall also being set ablaze.

world.title: France's unrest spills across borders as protests turn violent in Belgium, Italy
world.summary: Violent protests against rising living costs and public services have spread from France to Belgium and Italy. In Milan, clashes occurred between police and "Italia in Piazza" protesters, leading to significant unrest. Demonstrators expressed frustration over economic conditions, prompting confrontations with law enforcement. The situation highlights a growing wave of discontent across Europe regarding economic challenges and public service issues.

world.title: Who is Mehrdad Akhlaghi, Iran’s new tech-focused defence minister?
world.summary: Mehrdad Akhlaghi Ketabchi has been appointed as Iran’s new defence minister, focusing on ballistic missiles, aerospace technology, and defence-industrial production. His appointment comes amid rising tensions with the United States. The 68-year-old was approved by parliament during an online session, reflecting the ongoing challenges faced by the Iranian government in the current geopolitical landscape.

business.title: Crude oil prices brace for volatile week as supply disruptions remain a concern: Analysts
business.summary: Crude oil prices are expected to experience volatility this week due to ongoing supply disruptions in West Asia and stalled negotiations between the US and Iran. The Strait of Hormuz, a crucial shipping route, poses significant uncertainty, as any interruptions could further tighten global oil supplies. Analysts warn that these factors will keep markets on high alert.

business.title: Brazilian Man Sells Everything, Travels 1,900 Km To Meet Girlfriend. She Turned Out To Be AI
business.summary: A 49-year-old Brazilian man, Edimar Martins, sold all his possessions and traveled over 1,200 miles (1,931 km) to meet a woman he believed was his future partner. After struggling with loneliness following his mother's death, he was convinced she could help him start anew. Upon arrival, he discovered that the woman was an AI-generated character.

business.title: India Bars Sugar-Based Ethanol From 2026-27 Tender For Petrol Blend
business.summary: India's Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd (BPCL) has issued a tender for approximately 11 billion litres of ethanol for the 2026-27 supply year, aimed at achieving a 20% ethanol blend in petrol. However, the tender excludes ethanol derived from sugarcane juice, sugar syrup, and B-heavy molasses, as the government aims to protect domestic sugar interests.

technology.title: TECNO SPARK 50s 5G Budget Smartphone Launched In India: Check Price, Specifications, Features
technology.summary: TECNO has launched the SPARK 50s 5G smartphone in India, targeting budget-conscious consumers. It features a 6,500mAh battery and a rugged design for enhanced durability. Priced at Rs. 19,999, the device aims to provide strong connectivity and reliable daily performance. The phone will be available through offline retail channels, catering to users seeking affordable 5G options.

technology.title: TECNO Spark 50S 5G review: Sleek design, capable camera and decent performance
technology.summary: TECNO launched the Spark 50S 5G in India, featuring a 120Hz display, 6,500mAh battery, and MediaTek Dimensity 6400 processor. The smartphone is designed for the mid-range market, offering a sleek appearance and a 50MP camera. It aims to attract consumers looking for a balance of performance and style in an affordable device.

technology.title: Samsung rolls out Diwali offers on Bespoke AI appliances with cashback, zero down payment
technology.summary: Samsung India has introduced festive offers on its Bespoke AI home appliances in anticipation of Diwali. The promotions include cashback of up to Rs 20,000, zero down payment options, and extended warranty benefits. These offers aim to enhance consumer purchasing experiences during the festive season, making it more accessible for customers to acquire Samsung's innovative home appliance technology.

sports.title: Jose Mourinho admits Vinicius Junior should've joined Arsenal before Real Madrid U
sports.summary: Jose Mourinho stated that Vinicius Junior should have joined Arsenal instead of signing a new contract with Real Madrid. Arsenal made an effort to acquire the 26-year-old during the summer transfer window, but he ultimately chose to remain with Real Madrid. Mourinho's comments highlight the missed opportunity for Arsenal in securing the talented forward before his contract renewal.

sports.title: Perry powers nervy Australia to 1-0 lead
sports.summary: Australia Women secured a 1-0 lead in their series against New Zealand Women, winning by three runs. Australia, chasing 163, faced challenges, collapsing to 145 for 7 before finishing at 165 for 8. Ellyse Perry scored 52 runs, while Beth Mooney contributed 38. New Zealand's Jess Kerr took 3 wickets for 25 runs in a tense match.

sports.title: Ranji Trophy, Round 2, Day 1 Highlights: Shubman Gill disappoints; Priyansh Arya, Rinku Singh and Badoni hit tons
sports.summary: In the Ranji Trophy Round 2, Day 1, Shubman Gill's return was disappointing as he scored only one run and was dismissed after five balls against Chhattisgarh. In contrast, Priyansh Arya, Rinku Singh, and Badoni each scored centuries, contributing significantly to their teams. The day's play concluded with notable performances overshadowing Gill's brief innings.

health.title: Congo Confirms Ebola Outbreak Spreads to Eighth Province
health.summary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached its eighth province, North Ubangi, according to the country's public health institute. This development presents new challenges for health authorities already working to manage the outbreak. The National Institute for Biomedical Research has confirmed two cases in North Ubangi, including one fatality.

health.title: Chest pain that comes and goes without warning: When should you seek medical help, and when is it a cause for concern
health.summary: Chest pain that resolves on its own can still signal a heart issue, according to a cardiothoracic surgeon. Common misconceptions about heart attacks, often influenced by media portrayals, may lead individuals to underestimate symptoms. It is crucial to monitor any recurring or unexplained chest pain and seek medical advice when necessary, as early intervention can be vital for heart health.

health.title: World Menopause Day: Ayush Ministry stresses awareness, comprehensive care and research
health.summary: On World Menopause Day, October 18, the Ministry of Ayush emphasized the need for increased awareness, open discussions, and timely care regarding menopause. The ministry focused on the importance of physical health, emotional well-being, and overall quality of life. Through the Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences, it aims to promote preventive care and research into Ayurvedic methods.

science.title: Honeybees are pushing out wild pollinators in race for nectar
science.summary: A recent study indicates that rising honeybee populations are displacing wild pollinators, such as bumblebees, in their competition for nectar. Honeybees tend to dominate interactions, collecting more pollen and nectar. Additionally, other flower visitors actively avoided honeybees in 28.4% of encounters on bramble and 35.6% on ivy, highlighting their impact on wild pollinator populations.

science.title: Gas knots discovered in Pa 30 linked to SN 1181
science.summary: The Gemini North telescope in Hawaii has captured detailed images of Pa 30, a supernova remnant linked to SN 1181. The images reveal that the filaments consist of chains of small gas knots rather than continuous streams of material. This discovery enhances understanding of the structure and composition of supernova remnants and their evolution over time.

science.title: Satellite radiation: blocking the view
science.summary: A study published in the Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society highlights that communications satellites in low-earth orbit emit radio signals that disrupt astronomical observations across various frequencies. Conducted under the SNIFFLES project, the findings indicate that regulating licensed transmissions and stray radiation from onboard electronics is essential to protect the interests of astronomers.

entertainment.title: Vidyut Jammwal is 'more Dhalsim than Dhalsim', says 'Street Fighter' director Kitao Sakurai: 'He owns it, and he’s so proud of it'
entertainment.summary: Vidyut Jammwal is set to make his Hollywood debut as Dhalsim in the upcoming film 'Street Fighter.' Director Kitao Sakurai praised Jammwal for embodying the character, stating he brings the necessary realism to the role. Sakurai emphasized Jammwal's connection with Dhalsim, highlighting the actor's pride in portraying the iconic character ahead of the film's release on October.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Tomorrow, October 19, 2026: A quiet realization may help you make an important decision without seeking outside approval
entertainment.summary: On October 19, 2026, horoscopes suggest that a quiet realization may guide individuals in making important decisions independently. The day emphasizes strengthening relationships through mutual understanding and honest communication. Engaging in partnerships or conversations could help resolve concerns and foster support. Professionally, collaboration is encouraged, potentially leading to beneficial breakthroughs and enhanced teamwork across various sun signs.

entertainment.title: Jailer 2 Box Office Collection Day 3 Updates: Rajinikanth’s film eyes Rs 400 crore mark; Nelson shares photo with Rajini
entertainment.summary: Rajinikanth's film "Jailer 2" has grossed over Rs 317.15 crore worldwide in its first three days. On Sunday, the film earned Rs 28.09 crore net in India from 8,541 shows. The total net collection in India now stands at Rs 400 crore. Director Nelson shared a photo with Rajinikanth, highlighting the film's success.
